name: core-runtime-install-context-accessors
notes: Deterministic local install-context callbacks only; uppercase InstallerId remains version-bound and receives no execution credit.
salesforceExclusionReason: API 67 clean-org rejects the fixture's InstallContext member shape; retained as local runtime evidence and excluded from hosted parity.

source.content: public class LocalInstallScript implements InstallHandler { public static Boolean sawFresh = false; public static Boolean sawUpgrade = false; public void onInstall(InstallContext context) { if (context.previousVersion() == null) { sawFresh = !context.isPush() && context.installerId() == null; } else { sawUpgrade = context.previousVersion().compareTo(new Version(1, 47, 1)) < 0 && context.previousVersion().toString() == '1.47.0' && context.isPush() && context.installerId() == null; } } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeInstallContextAccessorsTest { @isTest static void accessorsComeFromTestInstallContext() { Test.testInstall(new LocalInstallScript(), null); Test.testInstall(new LocalInstallScript(), new Version(1, 47, 0), true); System.assert(LocalInstallScript.sawFresh); System.assert(LocalInstallScript.sawUpgrade); } }
